                              FRIDAY, OCTOBER 2, 2026

    Printed daily by the State of Iowa during the sessions of the General Assembly. An
 official corrected copy is available for reference in the Secretary of the Senate’s Office.
 (The official bound copy will be available after a reasonable time upon adjournment.)

1040                    JOURNAL OF THE SENATE                             1st Day

             JOURNAL OF THE SENATE

                         FIRST CALENDAR DAY
                          FIRST SESSION DAY
                       EXTRAORDINARY SESSION

                              Senate Chamber
                  Des Moines, Iowa, Friday, October 2, 2026

   Pursuant to the proclamation of the Governor, the Honorable Kim
Reynolds, convening the Ninety-first General Assembly in
Extraordinary Session, the Senate was called to order at 9:07 a.m. by
the Honorable Amy Sinclair, President of the Senate.

[...]

                          FINAL ADJOURNMENT

  By virtue of Senate Concurrent Resolution 104, duly adopted,
President Sinclair declared the 2026 Extraordinary Session of the
Ninety-first General Assembly adjourned sine die.
